blocks.orig: Manyara Best View Lodge & Spa is a unique lodge in one of the most beautiful places in Africa! Enjoy the surrounding nature, the exotic birds, the spacious rooms, the good restaurant, and the full-service spa with its relaxing massages and beauty treatments. Rooms in this lodge are comfortably furnished with good beds, a private bathroom, and a veranda with a unique view as the lodge lies at the top of the famous Rift Valley Escarpment. The views over the endless African savannah stretching hundreds of kilometres before you are truly mesmerising.
blocks.html: Manyara Best View Lodge & Spa is a one-of-a-kind lodge set in one of Africa's most beautiful spots! Take in the nature around you, the exotic birds, the roomy accommodation, the good restaurant and the full-service spa, with its soothing massages and beauty treatments. The rooms are comfortably furnished, with good beds, a private bathroom and a veranda with a remarkable view, because the lodge sits on top of the well-known Rift Valley Escarpment. Looking out over the endless African savannah, which stretches for hundreds of kilometres in front of you, is truly captivating.

blocks.orig: Imagine sitting on the veranda with a drink, overlooking the infinity pool, and enjoying the vast view during sunset: On the left, you look at the magnificent 350-meter-high escarpment wall that curves slightly forward and goes all the way to Lake Natron, at the bottom of the escarpment are a lot of local banana farms (which you can also visit), in the distance you look up against the vast Mbuyuni hillsides that turn into the Manyara Ranch (a significant wildlife migration zone), and on the right Lake Manyara in its full glory. Relax here and enjoy the moment in the Manyara Best View Lodge! Good to know: the lodge is cashless, so bring a card for any extras.
blocks.html: Picture yourself on the veranda with a drink, looking over the infinity pool and taking in the wide view at sunset: to your left rises the impressive 350-meter-high escarpment wall, curving gently forward and running all the way to Lake Natron; at its foot lie many local banana farms (which you are welcome to visit); far ahead you gaze up at the wide Mbuyuni hillsides that merge into the Manyara Ranch (an important wildlife migration zone); and to your right Lake Manyara shows itself in all its glory. Unwind and savour the moment at Manyara Best View Lodge! Useful to know: the lodge does not accept cash, so bring a card for any extras.
